summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for the issuance of $850M aggregate principal amount of 4.500% Senior Notes due 2033. The notes price at 99.741% of par with a 0.400% underwriting discount, yielding net proceeds of approximately $844.4M. Interest is payable annually from July 2027. The notes are senior unsecured, rank equally with existing unsecured debt, and are not redeemable before maturity except upon a tax event. They will be issued in registered form. Application has been made for listing on Euronext Dublin's Global Exchange Market. This is a debt capital markets transaction, not an equity special situation.
